UFS 4.0 device fails to enumerate during cold boot on 1 in 50 units. Failure mode: M-PHY Gen4 link initialization succeeds at HS-G3 but fails to negotiate HS-G5 boost.

Bootloader UFS log:
  [ufs] UIC link startup: OK
  [ufs] HS-G3 negotiation: OK
  [ufs] HS-G5 boost request sent
  [ufs] DME_GET PA_PWRMODE timeout (200ms)
  [ufs] fallback to HS-G3, performance mode degraded

What in the M-PHY Gen4 link training would cause HS-G5 boost negotiation to fail intermittently? What role does RX squelch detection and CLK lane termination play in HS-G5 negotiation? Which UFSHCI v4.0 register exposes the PA_PWRMODE state machine?
